items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: I resent the fact that somebody is going to try to compare me to you or you to Richard Davis or to Ron Carter or anybody else that we want to name.

ctx.x: Yeah, it's rough man. And that bothers me man and it bothers not only me, it bothers a whole lot of people, you know because it's unfair.

Just like I was saying before, that's what bothers me about it because I resent the fact that somebody is going to try to compare me to you or you to Richard Davis or to Ron Carter or anybody else that we want to name. I mean because I respect you and what you do and I listened to you and have always respected and loved what you do because I respect your individuality and I hold it in that regard. I don't listen to you saying man we should have done that like Ray Brown did or Oscar Pettiford did. No, damn that. I…

you feel about music, about how you as a painter, I mean like when you paint your pictures with your instrument and your music, how you feel about music, th at's what's important to me not just sit up and try to say he didn't quite do it like somebody else. To me that's a bunch of crap.
